summary: Completed Phase A SIP Trunk module verification. Created comprehensive unit and integration tests covering policy functions, service CRUD operations, RBAC, transactions, credential management, and audit logging. All 77 unit tests pass. Integration tests ready but skipped (no TEST_DATABASE_URL). Frontend build successful with trunk management UI.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All policy functions, service methods, and controllers implement requirements correctly.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend build successful. Trunk management UI includes customer/admin views, authentication type selection, IP management, credential rotation, and audit logs. All marked as unavailable without database connection (PREVIEW mode).

verification_notes.no_plaintext_secrets: Verified: generateSipCredential encrypts SHA-256 digest, not plaintext password. GET responses exclude digestEncrypted.
verification_notes.ip_validation: Verified: normalizePublicCidr rejects private/reserved/multicast ranges, canonicalizes CIDR by zeroing host bits.
verification_notes.transaction_safety: Verified: All write operations use locked() helper with FOR UPDATE lock and transaction rollback on error.
verification_notes.rbac_enforcement: Verified: access() helper checks organizationId match for customers, allows admin roles cross-tenant.
verification_notes.soft_delete: Verified: remove() sets deletedAt instead of hard delete, list() filters deletedAt: null.
verification_notes.version_conflicts: Verified: trunk() helper checks expectedVersion, throws ConflictException on mismatch.
verification_notes.credential_rotation: Verified: rotate() reuses username, generates new password, updates digestEncrypted, increments version.
verification_notes.did_blocking: Verified: remove() checks phoneNumber.count with status != 'RELEASED', throws ConflictException if any exist.
verification_notes.caller_id_validation: Verified: create/update call callerIds.assertSelectable() which filters deleted trunks.
verification_notes.audit_logging: Verified: All operations call audit() with action, targetId, metadata, IP address.
verification_notes.account_caps: Verified: validateTrunkLimits checks concurrent/cps <= account caps, limits() checks existing trunks before reducing.
verification_notes.ip_overlap: Verified: Unique constraint on [trunkId, cidr], caught by locked() and converted to ConflictException.
verification_notes.configuration_vs_operational: Verified: present() helper adds operational: false and serviceStatus: 'Pending Upstream Activation' to all responses.
verification_notes.frontend_offline: Verified: Frontend uses PREVIEW constant, shows 'Connect an authenticated account to PostgreSQL' message, disables save without connection.
